title: XmartAgro frontend data
description: Static data for the XmartAgro panel in the shape of its API contract (summary, inputs, scenarios): one exploratory analysis at one NASA POWER point. Text fields are {key, en, es}. Nothing here is a forecast, a yield prediction or a recommendation. Every field has `x-used-in`: where the panel shows it.
x-used-in: The whole document: one file the panel reads, with no API call

text.description: A text in both languages. Show `en` or `es`; `key` is a stable id of the sentence in the label catalog.

season_counts.description: Number of historical seasons (or crop-years of a rotation) in each deficit class. A season is classed by the share of the crop's water demand left unmet in its critical stage: low below 10 %, moderate from 10 % to 30 %, high from 30 % (provisional team convention).

ok.description: Drops of low deficit: the water was enough (legend «tuvo agua»).

out.description: Drops of high deficit: the water ran short (legend «sin agua»).

drops.description: The same counts split into ten parts by largest remainder: one drop each, light to dark. It is a share of historical seasons, not a probability.
